title: Sentinel Ai Anti-cheat
description: Advanced AI-powered anti-cheat plugin for Minecraft servers with real-time detections, smart punishments, and Discord bot integration.
body:
![SentinelAI Minecraft anti-cheat plugin banner showcasing AI-powered cheat detection, Discord bot integration, server monitoring dashboard, punishment system, and real-time violation alerts for PaperMC, Spigot, and Purpur servers.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/91357f64e39160086157a4f01f06df8baddfc383.png)SentinelAI Pro — Advanced Minecraft Anti-Cheat

Advanced anti-cheat plugin for modern Paper servers with real-time detections, smart punishments, AntiBot protection, and Discord integration.

---

Overview

SentinelAI Pro is a Minecraft anti-cheat plugin designed for modern Paper servers. It helps server owners detect and prevent unfair gameplay using real-time movement analysis, combat checks, exploit protection, and automated punishments.

The plugin focuses on reducing false positives while maintaining reliable detections for common cheats and exploit behavior.

---

Features

Combat Checks

- KillAura detection
- Reach detection
- AutoClicker detection
- AimAssist detection
- TriggerBot detection
- Criticals detection
- Velocity / AntiKB checks

Movement Checks

- Fly detection
- Speed detection
- Timer detection
- NoFall detection
- AirJump detection
- Glide detection
- Spider detection
- Jesus detection
- ElytraFly detection
- Step detection
- Blink detection
- BoatFly detection

World Checks

- Nuker detection
- Scaffold detection
- FastBreak detection
- FastPlace detection
- AirPlace detection

Exploit Protection

- Packet flood protection
- Book exploit protection
- Sign exploit protection

---

AntiBot Protection

SentinelAI includes a built-in AntiBot system for protecting servers from join floods and automated attacks.

Features include:

- Multiple security levels
- Join rate limiting
- Suspicious username detection
- CAPTCHA verification
- Temporary IP blocking
- Automatic lockdown mode
- Discord alerts

---

Discord Integration

The plugin includes Discord integration for server monitoring and alerts.

Available commands include:

- "/status"
- "/player"
- "/alerts"
- "/checks"
- "/punish"
- "/resetvl"

---

Admin Features

- Inventory-based admin panel
- Live player monitoring
- Per-check enable/disable controls
- Violation tracking
- Punishment management
- Database logging

---

Database Support

Supported databases:

- SQLite
- MySQL

The plugin stores:

- Violation history
- Punishment logs
- Player records
- Detection metrics

---

Performance

SentinelAI is designed to run efficiently on modern Paper servers.

Optimizations include:

- Async database operations
- Reduced movement processing
- Bounded data storage
- Alert cooldowns
- TPS-aware detection adjustments

---

Commands

Command| Description
"/sentinel panel"| Open admin GUI
"/sentinel reload"| Reload configuration
"/sentinel info <player>"| View player information
"/sentinel vl <player>"| View violations
"/sentinel history <player>"| View violation history
"/sentinel punish <player>"| Punish player
"/sentinel reset <player>"| Reset violations

Aliases:
"/sentinelai"
"/sai"
"/anticheat"
"/ac"

---

Permissions

Permission| Description
"sentinelai.admin"| Admin access
"sentinelai.view"| View violations
"sentinelai.bypass"| Bypass checks

---

Requirements

Requirement| Version
Paper / Spigot| 1.20.x – 1.21.x
Java| 21+
ProtocolLib| Optional

---

Installation

1. Place "SentinelAI.jar" inside the "plugins/" folder
2. Restart the server
3. Configure the plugin in "plugins/SentinelAI/config.yml"
4. Run "/sentinel reload"

---

Support

If you find bugs or need help with setup, configuration, or compatibility, contact us through Discord or the project support page.
